name: pi-my-web
description: Web UI for pi: multi-session chat, standalone daemon with password login, themes, i18n (en/zh), usage details and a session manager.
author: BBDXF (https://github.com/BBDXF)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:web & npm run dev:server
scripts.smoke: node --input-type=module -e "await import('./server/hub.js'); await import('./server/http.js'); await import('./server/sse-protocol.js'); console.log('smoke ok')"
scripts.test: npm run smoke && node --import ./server/test-setup.js --test --test-timeout=60000 server/stabilize.test.js server/sse-protocol.test.js server/http.contract.test.js server/skill-workspace.test.js server/test-temp.test.js server/customization.test.js server/auth-stored.test.js server/subagents.test.js server/agent-types.test.js && node --experimental-strip-types --test web/src/lib/chat-stream.test.ts web/src/lib/special-message.test.ts web/src/lib/tool-presentation.test.ts web/src/lib/work-section.test.ts extensions/gui.test.ts

contributors: Ankit Chouhan (https://github.com/ankitchouhan1020) — original author of pi-gui-extension
